source_task.scope: One accepted real drafting task plus assisted external completion. This triage inspects its controller residuals; it is not a fresh performance trial.
source_task.deployment: Scoped documents and task completed; no general runtime qualification.
source_task.controller_corrections_definition: Controller-to-worker repair rounds only. Export failures, browser refreshes, login assistance and layout correction are separate observations; their total intervention count is unknown.

attempts.mechanical_check_scope: Two final-output JSON validator receipts only; factual and visual acceptance were separate.

milestone_review.unselected_reason: All fifty current claim statements were reviewed. The observations support a narrow controller contract and reuse of existing validation. They do not select extra roles, parallelism, memory, model routing, compression, caching or a broader benchmark. Task sampling, cost accounting and independent acceptance remain prerequisites for any later performance comparison.

groups.decision: Qualify existing export-result checks and their extraction using valid controls and observed fault classes.
No new comparison: one assisted application cannot estimate marginal orchestration value. Preserve a competent native baseline and require task/cost/acceptance design first.
Keep ownership, authorization and native enforcement boundaries explicit. This offline check does not close general execution, browser, upgrade or publication gaps.
Reuse evidence and preserved failures. Complete accounting is unresolved. No new memory, cache, compression or feature-retirement policy follows from these cases.

gaps.observation: Two P008 exports exited zero without receipt or PDF. The final private guard already rejects missing output and checks input/output/options hashes; P006 also preserved a nonzero-child outcome issue.
gaps.cause_assessment: Process completion alone is insufficient evidence of an export. A working task-specific guard exists; the current engineering question is whether it can be reused without losing behavior.
alternative_explanations: The operating environment may explain the failed export itself; receipt validation detects it but does not establish the cause or repair permissions.
A receipt is produced by a trusted renderer; this is not adversarial attestation.
gaps.existing_capability: P008 render_receipt_from_stdout plus its caller's nonzero-exit check. Keep the working guard as the competent reference.
gaps.smallest_action: Utility extraction and offline qualification complete. Before adoption, wire one trusted export caller and check its complete artifact acceptance separately.
gaps.decision_reason: This failure has concrete saved evidence and can be checked offline without more solver runs.

qualification.procedure: Exercise nonzero exit, empty stdout, missing/empty file, stale input/output/options, duplicate receipts, valid JSON and mixed-log JSON lines against the extracted utility and reference semantics.
qualification.pass_condition: Every required invalid case rejected, every required valid case accepted, candidate/reference agree on supported overlap, and source bytes unchanged.
qualification.failure_condition: Any required invalid case accepted or valid case rejected; no claimed full PDF or freshness qualification.

gaps.observation: P008 had two final-byte JSON validations and independent content/PDF acceptance without a worker repair.
gaps.cause_assessment: Access to validation may have helped, but differing tasks and controller work prevent attributing the outcome to it.
alternative_explanations: The task may have been easier than earlier tasks.
Existing model behavior and improved input preparation may explain acceptance.
gaps.existing_capability: Native bounded worker with supplied file tools and the existing static validator; independent content/layout review.
gaps.smallest_action: Reuse the qualified validator path with actual post-write receipts.
gaps.decision_reason: One accepted draft does not justify adding another reviewer role or more prompt stages.

qualification.procedure: On the next admitted task verify the provided validator is callable and its last receipts match final artifacts.
qualification.pass_condition: Observed final-output validation and separately accepted content.
qualification.failure_condition: Missing access, stale receipt, or failed independent content.

gaps.observation: Browser targets became stale and login required user intervention.
gaps.cause_assessment: Reusing obsolete targets plausibly caused interaction corrections. No precise count or general enforcement guarantee was measured.
alternative_explanations: Asynchronous UI loading and session expiry are distinct causes.
Text extraction can omit a field value even when the UI contains it.
gaps.existing_capability: Existing supported browser state refresh and one controller owner.
gaps.smallest_action: Use fresh observed targets; qualify any future browser adapter separately before broader automation.
gaps.decision_reason: A local export check can be completed independently; new browser infrastructure is not needed for it.

qualification.procedure: Before an external action, inspect the current page and intended target; reconcile uncertain external effects before retrying.
qualification.pass_condition: The target and intended state are observed immediately before the action.
qualification.failure_condition: Target cannot be verified, required sign-in is absent, or external effect remains uncertain.

gaps.observation: Independent review rejected an orphan document heading; a local layout correction later passed.
gaps.cause_assessment: Structural syntax/hash checks did not establish acceptable page layout. Separate rendering and visual inspection caught the specific defect.
alternative_explanations: Other layouts or renderers may require different corrections; this is not universal pagination coverage.
gaps.existing_capability: Existing page rendering and independent visual acceptance.
gaps.smallest_action: Keep visual acceptance separate from transport validation and reuse the documented heading rule where relevant.
gaps.decision_reason: This does not require an additional agent mechanism; it requires preserving an existing check.

qualification.procedure: Render every delivered page and inspect heading/section placement and content against the source.
qualification.pass_condition: All pages satisfy the actual layout/content contract.
qualification.failure_condition: Any orphan heading, clipping, missing content or uninspected page.

gaps.observation: Worker usage is recorded, while controller/reviewer preparation, failed export work and human effort lack complete attributable totals.
gaps.cause_assessment: The historical total cannot be computed from the available worker-only figure.
alternative_explanations: Some host telemetry may be unavailable rather than absent from the recorder.
Human active time is not recoverable from message counts alone.
gaps.existing_capability: Existing observer and contact classification; retain unknowns instead of inferring zero.
gaps.smallest_action: Before a paid comparison, test whole-task accounting coverage and specify unknown-cost treatment.
gaps.decision_reason: A cost/acceptance claim cannot be evaluated honestly from worker usage alone.

qualification.procedure: Reconcile all known roles/attempts and mark coverage for preparation, evaluation and human work on a bounded prospective task.
qualification.pass_condition: Every category has an observed amount or explicit unknown coverage, with no double counting; funding claims state remaining limits.
qualification.failure_condition: Omitted unsuccessful work, double-counted shared work, or unknown recorded as zero.

limitations: This readiness record does not promote any of the fifty performance milestones.
Synthetic export checks establish only their named contract; they do not launch a renderer, qualify a sandbox, validate PDF pages or prove fresh execution.
P008 remains a private task; a public synthetic check does not reproduce that application.
Controller and reviewer model usage for preparing this checkpoint is unknown. No additional native paid worker experiment is dispatched.
current_decision: Reuse this qualified export check at the next trusted caller integration; collect complete per-role accounting before a paid performance comparison.
